shared_elements: bearded male figures in long fringed robes
row/procession of figures facing the same direction
figure with raised arm / gesturing hand
framed rectangular relief panel with figures filling the field
conical/pointed headgear on a principal figure
justification: Both depict a file of bearded, long-robed male figures in strict profile, facing the same way, with a leading figure raising a hand in gesture and carrying a rod-like implement, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in content is the composition: A places its small figures in a narrow arched register above a large field of dense script, with celestial/astral emblems overhead, while B has only two monumental figures with no inscription field or symbols and heavy fringed drapery detail.
